claims.claim: The song opens with eleven piano notes and is presented here as a bass play-along.
claims.assessment: Article records an 11 note piano introduction starting on G5. The play-along format is visible in the screenshots.

claims.claim: The piano line runs eleven notes and begins on a single G5.
claims.assessment: Stated in the music section, which gives the 11 note introduction and the starting G5.

claims.claim: This play-along runs 3:33 against a 5:11 album cut.
claims.assessment: Player duration shows 3:33. The article gives the album version at 5:11 and the radio edit at 4:37, so the copy says shorter than the record and does not claim to be the radio edit.

claims.claim: The note highway never leaves the frame and a bar can be retaken.
claims.assessment: Describes the Rocksmith chart overlay and standard playback controls. No claim about difficulty or game build.

claims.claim: Requests run on Kick, a parallel broadcast runs on Twitch, and Discord hosts the community.
claims.source: Standing channel practice in existing copy
claims.assessment: House order, Kick first and Discord last, one URL each. No stream schedule asserted.

claims.claim: Rob Cavallo first wrote the piano line for a separate album opener about a marching band crossing a city.
claims.assessment: Article states the band adopted Cavallo's idea for an album introduction depicting a marching band going through a city and added the instrumental portion to this song.

claims.claim: Open question about keeping the marching band as its own track.
claims.assessment: Opinion question anchored to the sourced fact. No factual claim in the question itself.

claims.claim: Dedicated play-along, routed to the Rocksmith 2014 Bass Play Along playlist rather than genre or All Genres lists.
claims.source: User standing rule, recorded in Ver 3.0/TXT/Play_Along_Series_ID_Map.md
claims.assessment: User reports it assigned to the Play Along playlist. Applies the standing rule for every play-along.

distinct_fact_and_source: The eleven note piano intro that opens on G5, plus the scrapped Cavallo album opener about a marching band passing through a city. Unused by the other six, which cover the MTV debut, the Hall of Fame listing, the Time ranking, the key change, the Burbank studio and the lead single argument. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Welcome_to_the_Black_Parade
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other package once the song title itself is set aside, checked against all 152 _03 - Copy.md files and the delivered review copy. The gate returns five signals for this video, every one of them the song title. Format wording is written apart from the A-M-E-R-I-C-A and Abigail play-along packages.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: The video runs 3:33 against a 5:11 album cut and a 4:37 radio edit, so the copy says the arrangement is shorter than the record and never calls it the radio edit. Stream timing, current playlist membership and live pin state are not asserted. Historical screenshots cannot establish live settings.
